groundTruth.rootCause: The shipping service's ship-order calls are delayed by 10sec (international shipping slowdown), so placing an order is slow.
acceptableAlternatives: slow ship-order requests in the shipping service

hypothesis: Most likely, but weakly supported: the shipping service's ShipOrder call is sometimes slow and drags out checkout PlaceOrder. In one order the gap between 'payment went through' (05:39:04.376) and shipping's 'Tracking ID Created' (05:39:14.381) was about 10 s, while other orders finished in about 10 ms. Shipping's overall p95 hides this because most of its calls are fast GetQuote requests. This is a single sample and it was logged after the alert started, so it does not explain the alert by itself.
